name: theme
title: IndiaCN UX4G theme
description: UX4G 2.0 design tokens — 8 semantic colors with 50–900 scales, focus-shadow utilities, radius ladder, and accordion/collapsible keyframes. Required by every IndiaCN component.

name: typography
title: Typography
description: 21 typography components: 6 Display, 6 Headline, 3 Title, 3 Label, 3 Body. Required by every other IndiaCN component.

name: button
title: Button
description: Versatile button with filled/outlined/tonal/text variants, primary/success/destructive themes, sm/md/lg sizes, icon support, and loading state.

name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: Groups related buttons horizontally or vertically with shared borders.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: Compact label for status, counts, or categories. 9 themes × 3 variants × 3 sizes × 2 shapes.

name: alert
title: Alert
description: Contextual feedback message. 8 themes (primary, secondary, success, danger, warning, info, light, dark) with optional dismiss button.

name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Vertically-stacked collapsible sections. Built on Radix Accordion primitive.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Navigation trail showing the current page's hierarchy.

name: card
title: Card
description: Composable container with header, content, footer, image, title, and description sub-parts.

name: chip
title: Chip
description: Tags, filters, or selections. 7 themes × 3 variants × 3 sizes; supports icons, avatars, dismiss, and selected state.

name: collapse
title: Collapse
description: Single collapsible region powered by Radix Collapsible.

name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: Dropdown menu with items, checkbox/radio items, sub-menus, separators, and shortcuts.

name: list-group
title: List Group
description: Vertical list with optional flush, horizontal, and contextual-color variants.

name: modal
title: Modal
description: Dialog with sm/md/lg/xl/fullscreen sizes and optional scrollable body.

name: offcanvas
title: Offcanvas
description: Slide-in panel from any side with optional body-scroll mode.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page navigation with default and flat variants in 3 sizes.

name: popover
title: Popover
description: Anchored floating panel powered by Radix Popover.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: Linear progress bar with theme colors, sizes, striped + animated stripes.

name: search
title: Search
description: Search input with icon, sizes, and optional clear button.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: Horizontal or vertical divider built on Radix Separator.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholder with rect/circle/pill/text shapes and pulse/wave animations.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: Loading indicator with border/grow variants, theme colors, and sm/md/lg sizes.

name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Step indicator for multi-step flows with horizontal/vertical orientation and completed/active/warning/pending states.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tab list with tabs, pills, and underline variants. Built on Radix Tabs.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: Notification toast with provider, hook, container, and theme variants.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Hover/focus tooltip with 8 theme variants. Built on Radix Tooltip.

name: label
title: Label
description: Accessible caption for a form control. Built on Radix Label.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Tri-state checkbox with checked, indeterminate, and unchecked types across five states. Built on Radix Checkbox.

name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Mutually exclusive options with a 40px state layer and AA focus ring. Built on Radix Radio Group.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: On/off toggle in default and small sizes; the handle grows on check per UX4G. Built on Radix Switch.

name: indicator
title: Indicator
description: Notification dot, count, or short status label. UX4G's Badge component.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Person or entity avatar with picture, initials, or icon fallback. Four sizes, circular or rectangular.

name: empty-state
title: Empty State
description: Centred placeholder for empty lists and panels, with a themable UX4G illustration.

name: input
title: Input
description: Text field with sizes, validation states, leading icon and clear button.

name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Multi-line text field with validation states and a character counter.

name: close-button
title: Close Button
description: Dismiss control for modals, toasts and panels, with a guaranteed accessible name.

name: progress-circle
title: Progress Circle
description: Circular and half-circular progress indicator with an optional caption.

name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: Slideshow with bar indicators, keyboard navigation and an accessible pause control.

name: accessibility-widget
title: Accessibility Widget
description: Floating panel of reading adjustments that apply to the whole document and persist.

name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: Government website header with a utility bar, brand, navigation and actions.

name: chart
title: Chart
description: Chart.js charts with UX4G presentation defaults and a screen-reader data table.

name: table
title: Table
description: Data table with a header, selectable rows, row headers and a footer.

name: footer
title: Footer
description: Government site footer with link columns, social links and a bottom bar.

name: feedback-widget
title: Feedback Widget
description: Edge tab opening a feedback form with a five-point rating.

name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Date grid with day, month and decade views and full keyboard support.

name: time-picker
title: Time Picker
description: Hour, minute and second columns driven as listboxes.

name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: Date, range, time and date-time pickers behind a field or icon trigger.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Single or range slider with optional value labels.
